MemoryIntent.description:
Classifies the human or AI intent of a persistent semantic memory. The agent can filter retrievals by intent
so a MemoryIntent.Warning survives an unrelated MemoryIntent.Todo sweep, and a MemoryIntent.Decision
can be queried separately from a MemoryIntent.Convention.
